title: Here’s What’s Leaving HIDIVE in September 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is only a month away, and it’s going to be another exciting quarter for fans. With the return of major shows such as Black Clover and The Apothecary Diaries , the schedule is already packed, and more will be announced at a later date.

title: Rev. Noir Game's 2nd Trailer Previews Story, Combat
content: Konami Digital Entertainment unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday the second trailer for its new role-playing game Rev. Noir . The video previews the story and combat gameplay: The single-player game is currently only slated for the PlayStation 5.
author: ANN

title: Final Fantasy Resonance Game Reveals Sephiroth, Demo
content: Square Enix unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance , a new HD-2D offline game based on the first story arc of the defunct Final Fantasy Brave Exvius smartphone game.
author: ANN

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Game Expansion's Trailer Introduces Gundoraja
content: CAPCOM revealed during Sony 's State of Play on Thursday the first trailer for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game, and it teases a new Elder Dragon Gundoraja. The Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance major expansion will launch in 2027.
author: ANN

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Unveils Video Clip
content: Sony Pictures Entertainment began streaming during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a video clip for the new live-action reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise .

content: The My Neighbor Totoro anime film aired on NTV on Friday, August 21 at 9:00 p.m. and it earned a 10.0% rating. The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region.

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists
content: The second season will premiere on October 1. The new season will again air on Thursdays at 11:56 p.m. (10:56 a.m. EDT) on TBS and 27 affiliated channels. It will also stream on Netflix , as well as other services in Japan.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Ending Featuring "Michishirube" by Keita Tachibana
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first ending, featuring the song “Michishirube” by Keita Tachibana. The song was used in Episodes 1-12, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fungus and Iron TV Anime Reveals Director, Yokohama Animation Lab Animation Studio
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayaka Katayama 's Fungus and Iron ( Kin to Tetsu ) manga revealed the anime's second teaser visual and director, on Thursday.
